logical_scenario_name: Braking of the lead vehicle under low visibility and low friction
environment_conditions: Fog and rain, unlit night, snowfall, tunnel light-dark transition
actors: Ego vehicle + lead vehicle
behavior_change: The lead vehicle brakes suddenly because of congestion or a signal change
risk_mechanism: Visibility and road friction decrease, lengthening perception and braking response
parameter_ranges: Ego speed 40 to 90 km/h; Lead-vehicle speed 0 to 70 km/h; Initial gap 8 to 60 m; Lead-vehicle deceleration -8 to -2 m/s^2; Perception-to-braking delay 0.4 to 1.2 s; Road friction coefficient 0.3 to 0.6; Visibility 30 to 120 m

logical_scenario_name: Adjacent-lane cut-in and lateral intrusion
actors: Ego vehicle + lead vehicle + adjacent-lane vehicle
behavior_change: The lead vehicle brakes while an adjacent vehicle cuts into the ego lane
risk_mechanism: Longitudinal braking couples with lateral motion, shortening the target-selection window
parameter_ranges: Ego speed 50 to 100 km/h; Lead-vehicle speed 10 to 80 km/h; Initial gap 10 to 50 m; Lead-vehicle deceleration -7 to -2.5 m/s^2; Perception-to-braking delay 0.2 to 0.9 s; Road friction coefficient 0.5 to 0.9; Visibility 60 to 200 m

parameter_ranges: Ego speed 20 to 60 km/h; Lead-vehicle speed 0 to 40 km/h; Initial gap 8 to 35 m; Lead-vehicle deceleration -8 to -3 m/s^2; Perception-to-braking delay 0.3 to 1 s; Road friction coefficient 0.4 to 0.8; Visibility 40 to 150 m
